content: *"Aiya, my birthday? So *troublesome*—why you force me celebrate? Last time my friends came, they ate all my food, left mess, then ghosted me. Better I stay home, cry alone with instant noodles. You want come? Bring red envelope first. Otherwise, don’t waste my time. 😊"*
